menu.title: International Bloc Membership
menu.infoDescription: Explore UN organizations, specialized agencies, and regional organizations. Open an organization to review membership, information, and cooperation opportunities available to your country.

organizationNames.unesco: UN Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO)
organizationNames.brics: BRICS (Brazil, Russia, India, China, South Africa)
organizationNames.opec: Organization of the Petroleum Exporting Countries (OPEC)
organizationNames.oecd: Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD)

default.description: An international cooperation forum for member countries.
default.focus: Dialogue and policy coordination among members.

interpol.description: An organization that helps member countries' police forces cooperate against cross-border crime.
interpol.focus: Police information sharing, international assistance coordination, and cross-border crime enforcement.

who.description: A UN agency that directs and coordinates international cooperation on health.
who.focus: Public health, outbreak response, and global health guidance.

unesco.description: A UN agency that promotes cooperation in education, science, and culture.
unesco.focus: Education, heritage preservation, science, and freedom of expression.

wto.description: An organization providing rules for international trade and a forum for resolving trade disputes.
wto.focus: Trade rules, negotiations, and dispute settlement among members.

ilo.description: A UN agency advancing workers' rights and decent employment standards.
ilo.focus: Labour standards, worker protection, and dialogue among governments, employers, and workers.

fao.description: A UN agency leading international efforts to end hunger and improve food security.
fao.focus: Agriculture, food, nutrition, and sustainable natural-resource management.

imo.description: A UN agency developing safety and environmental-protection rules for international shipping.
imo.focus: Ship safety, maritime security, and prevention of marine pollution.

itu.description: A UN agency coordinating radio spectrum, satellite orbits, and telecommunications standards.
itu.focus: Global connectivity and development of information and communication technologies.

wmo.description: A UN agency facilitating global cooperation on weather, climate, and water observations.
wmo.focus: Meteorological data, early warnings, climate, and hydrology.

asean.description: A regional organization promoting cooperation and integration among Southeast Asian countries.
asean.focus: Regional political-security, economic, and socio-cultural cooperation.
asean.requirement: The country must be in Southeast Asia.

eu.description: A political and economic union of European countries with shared institutions and policies.
eu.focus: A common market, cross-border policies, and regional cooperation.
eu.requirement: The country must be in Europe.

arabLeague.description: A regional organization promoting coordination and ties among Arab member states.
arabLeague.focus: Political, economic, cultural, and social consultation and cooperation.
arabLeague.requirement: The country must be in the Middle East or North Africa.

africanUnion.description: A continental organization promoting unity, peace, and development in Africa.
africanUnion.focus: African integration, conflict resolution, and sustainable development.
africanUnion.requirement: The country must be in Africa.

oic.description: An intergovernmental organization strengthening cooperation and solidarity among its members.
oic.focus: Political consultation, development, humanitarian assistance, and issues affecting the Muslim world.
oic.requirement: Islam must be the country's main religion.

brics.description: A cooperation forum for BRICS countries to strengthen dialogue and coordination on global issues.
brics.focus: Economic cooperation, development, and coordination in global governance.
brics.requirement: Relations with both China and Russia must score above 50.

nato.description: A collective-defense alliance of member states in the North Atlantic and Europe.
nato.focus: Security consultation and collective defense under the alliance treaty.
nato.requirement: The country must be in North America or Europe.

opec.description: An organization of oil-exporting countries that coordinates members' petroleum policies.

g20.description: An international economic cooperation forum for major economies, the European Union, and the African Union.
g20.focus: Global economic coordination, financial stability, and development.
g20.requirement: The country must rank among the world's top 20 economies by GDP.
